directional_signal: Mean of three closed-hour normalized EMA differences:48/192,168/672,672/2688hours. Normalize each price difference by current close times maximum of EWMA168/720 hourly return volatility times sqrt((slow-fast)/2). At four-hour closed clocks enter at absolute mean>=0.5 and at least two directions agree; exit when signed mean<=0.1 or close-based trailing retreat>=4*hourlyvol_at_entry*sqrt24 from most favorable observed closed log price. Cooldown24hours after exit. This is delayed market execution, not filling at the trailing threshold. No maximum holding chosen after results.
allocation: Use conservative full-covariance168h and720h EWMA portfolio volatility estimates with0.1%hourly diagonal floor. Each sleeve starts from fixed risk share divided by its own estimated daily volatility; directions combine and net at the two contract instruments. Portfolio then scaled to annual risk20/30%. Confidence multiplier0.5..1 and gross ceiling min(cap,0.5+meanactiveconfidence); long/short relative positions can offset, but nominal gross excludes imaginary separate accounts. Confidence is a heuristic score, NOT probability of success.
